plugin.note: Use melee with Protect from Melee where possible. Iorwerth Dungeon is the strongest post-Song of the Elves option because it has 13 warriors, cannon support, safespots, crystal shards, and enhanced crystal teleport seed access; the wiki still recommends many players skip elf tasks when possible.

requirements: Completion of Regicide to receive the task
Mourning's End Part I progress for Lletya and Mourner Headquarters options
Full Mourner gear for normal Mourner Headquarters access unless Mourning's End Part II access route is available
Song of the Elves for Prifddinas and Iorwerth Dungeon
Adept Reanimation and ensouled elf heads for the reanimated elf option
mechanics: Elves use either ranged or melee depending on their weapon.
Archers wield crystal bows and attack with Ranged.
Warriors, Mourners, and Prifddinas guards wield crystal halberds or halberd-style weapons and attack with melee from up to two tiles away.
Protect from Melee is effective against the halberd variants; the slower attack cycle makes prayer flicking practical.
Ranged or Magic safespots are available at Iorwerth Camp, Lletya, Iorwerth Dungeon, and several Prifddinas guard locations.
Iorwerth Dungeon warriors and Prifddinas guards can drop crystal shards and enhanced crystal teleport seeds.
Only level 108 Mourners downstairs count for the task; Mourners at any other level do not count.
Reanimated elves give 35 Slayer XP and 754 Prayer XP.

methods.label: Iorwerth Dungeon
methods.summary: Kill the 13 Iorwerth Warriors in Iorwerth Dungeon after Song of the Elves for the best normal Elf task option.
recommendedFor: Players with Song of the Elves complete
Players wanting crystal shards or enhanced crystal teleport seeds
requiredOrKeyItems: Proselyte armour or other prayer gear
Ranged or Magic weapon for safespotting
steps: Enter Iorwerth Dungeon after Song of the Elves and go to the Iorwerth Warrior room.
Use a dwarf multicannon if speeding up the task.
Fight with melee and Protect from Melee, or safespot with Ranged or Magic.
For the western-room safespot, attack an Iorwerth Warrior while it is across the red-line area and move into the spaces around fabric panels so it traps north or south of the player.
Account for the warriors' crystal halberd range; they can hit from two tiles away if the safespot spacing is wrong.
Loot crystal shards and enhanced crystal teleport seed drops when safe.
risks: Standing only one tile away from a halberd warrior is not a safespot.
This method requires Song of the Elves.
inventory: Teleport crystal or other Prifddinas access
High alchemy runes for rune dagger and green dragonhide drops
notes: The task page calls out Iorwerth Dungeon as notable because it contains 13 warriors and allows cannon use.

methods.label: Prifddinas guards
methods.summary: Use Prifddinas guards after Song of the Elves when their nearby banks, altar, Spirit tree, or house portal are more convenient than Iorwerth Dungeon.
recommendedFor: Players with Song of the Elves complete
Players choosing gate or Tower of Voices spawns
steps: Choose a Prifddinas guard spot based on nearby utilities: East Gate for bank, North Gate for bank/altar/Spirit tree, West Gate for house portal, or Tower of Voices for central access.
Use melee and Protect from Melee against the halberd guards.
Use the documented safespots by attacking guards from outside their wander radius and pushing them against gates or terrain.
At the market place, safespot by shooting over Glenda.
Avoid the Tower of Voices upper walkways if efficiency matters because the task page notes great distances between guards.
notes: Prifddinas guards share crystal shard and enhanced crystal teleport seed value with other post-Song of the Elves options.

methods.label: Lletya prayer melee
methods.summary: Use Lletya's bank, upstairs altar, and shop access to sustain melee kills after Mourning's End Part I progress.
recommendedFor: Players without Song of the Elves
steps: Travel to Lletya after enough Mourning's End Part I progress.
Use melee against Elf Warriors while protecting from melee.
Recharge Prayer at the upstairs altar in the house where Arianwyn is located.
Use the nearby bank to restock or deposit loot.
Buy emergency food from the upstairs food shop if needed.
notes: The wiki notes Lletya is more convenient than Iorwerth Camp once unlocked because of the nearby bank and altar.

methods.label: Ranged or Magic safespots
methods.summary: Use Ranged or Magic safespots for lower-level accounts or low-supply kills.
recommendedFor: Iorwerth Camp, Lletya, Iorwerth Dungeon, and Prifddinas safespots
steps: Use Ranged or Magic from safespots rather than standing in halberd range.
At Lletya, use the west bench, pillars behind fences, entrance bench area, or wall closest to Arianwyn.
At Iorwerth Camp, use stools or spear-walls and stay one extra tile away so crystal halberds cannot reach.
Do not rely on moss-covered rocks at Iorwerth Camp; the wiki notes they cannot be fired over and are not safespots.
At Iorwerth Dungeon, use the western fabric-panel spaces.
For Prifddinas market guards, shoot over Glenda.
risks: Player halberds are very slow and not recommended for the Lletya safespot approach.
Halberd-wielding elves can hit from two tiles away.

methods.label: Iorwerth Camp
methods.summary: Use Iorwerth Camp when only Regicide access is available, accepting awkward travel and cannon placement.
recommendedFor: Players willing to use camp safespots
requiredOrKeyItems: Ranged or Magic weapon for safespotting
steps: Travel to Iorwerth Camp, preferably with an Iorwerth camp teleport.
Kill Iorwerth Archers or Iorwerth Warriors; both count for Elves tasks.
Use stools or spear-walls to safespot warriors and stay at least two tiles away.
Use the fireplace and fly fishing spot if you need to make emergency food.
Avoid relying on the cannon for efficiency because the camp layout is impeded by tents, barrels, and crates.
notes: The task page says Iorwerth Camp is the only regular option before Lletya access.

methods.label: Mourner Headquarters
methods.summary: Kill the four level 108 Mourners downstairs only during the quest window before Song of the Elves removes them.
recommendedFor: Players during Mourning's End Part I or II
Players before Song of the Elves
Players using Slayer ring access after Mourning's End Part II
requiredOrKeyItems: Slayer ring after Mourning's End Part II
steps: Wear full Mourner gear while inside Mourner Headquarters unless using the later Mourning's End Part II route.
Go downstairs; only the level 108 Mourners count for Elves tasks.
Use melee and Protect from Melee, or safespot if positioning allows.
Use High alchemy on frequent green dragonhide body, green dragonhide chaps, and rune dagger drops.
Do not plan this method after Song of the Elves; the Mourners are no longer there.
risks: Mourners at any level other than 108 do not count.
The method disappears after Song of the Elves.

methods.label: Reanimated elf
methods.summary: Use Adept Reanimation on ensouled elf heads for Prayer XP at the cost of much lower Slayer and combat XP.
requiredOrKeyItems: Dark Altar access if the local reanimation window is lost
steps: Obtain ensouled elf heads as drops or through the Grand Exchange.
Cast Adept Reanimation near the dropped head if it has not been banked, traded, put on the Grand Exchange, price-checked, or moved out of range.
If the head can no longer be reanimated locally, take it to the Dark Altar and cast Adept Reanimation there.
Kill the reanimated elf for 35 Slayer XP and 754 Prayer XP.
risks: This method gives much less Slayer and combat XP than killing normal elves.
It requires Arceuus spellbook access and reanimation supplies.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Bring prayer sustain, alchemy support, and teleports suited to the chosen quest-stage location.
recommendedFor: Long Iorwerth Dungeon or Prifddinas trips
inventory: Teleport crystal for Lletya or Prifddinas
Iorwerth camp teleport for early camp access
Slayer ring for Mourner Headquarters after Mourning's End Part II
High alchemy runes for green dragonhide bodies, chaps, and rune daggers
Cannon and cannonballs for Iorwerth Dungeon or supported non-multicombat locations
Ensouled elf heads and Arceuus runes if using reanimation
steps: Choose the location based on quest state: Iorwerth Camp after Regicide, Lletya after Mourning's End Part I progress, Iorwerth Dungeon or Prifddinas after Song of the Elves.
Bring Protect from Melee support for halberd variants.
Bring Ranged or Magic gear when using safespots instead of melee.
Keep crystal shard and enhanced crystal teleport seed drops from Prifddinas and Iorwerth Dungeon options.
notes: The task page recommends skipping elf tasks when possible because the assignment has lower weight from higher-level masters and the enhanced seed is rare.
